evidence: Citi lowered its target price for Samsung Electronics and cut its Q3 operating profit estimate from 115.5 trillion won to 104.1 trillion won (a 10% cut), citing currency headwinds (~5 trillion won impact) and weak mobile/appliance business.

Citi lowered its Q3 operating profit estimate for SK hynix by 3% to 74 trillion won from 76.7 trillion won, and trimmed its full-year estimate to 254.2 trillion won from 261.1 trillion won, citing currency drag, while keeping a Buy rating.
